blocks.text: Iñigo Pascual believes that his father, Piolo Pascual, will find love again when the time is right, saying he does not want to pressure him into entering a relationship. Iñigo was asked how he feels about his dad being single during TV5’s “Sa Tara Sa Paskong Kapatid” Thanksgiving Party in Taguig City on Monday, Nov. 9. “That’s his life. That’s his heart. My dad is a super sweet person. In God’s perfect timing he may find someone. I think I’m not going to be the one to put pressure on him. For me, no one should be doing that [pressure] anyone,” […]...
